name: Approvals
description: One row per approval/reminder handoff linked to a contract: title, summary, and status. The operator's decision (approve/request changes/block) is written directly onto this row -- there is no separate decisions/handoff-log bucket.

agentPrompts.label: Add an approval or reminder item
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-clm` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then add the approval/reminder handoff I describe for the contract I name, with a clear title and summary of what needs a decision.

agentPrompts.label: Record an approve / request-changes / block decision
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-clm` skill in this folder, then record the decision I give you (approve, request changes, or block) on the approval item I name, along with my note. Only record a decision I have explicitly told you to make.

agentPrompts.label: What approvals are still pending?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-clm` skill in this folder, then list the approval/reminder items still waiting on a decision, with their linked contract.
